gitCommit.subject: Separate release gates: PUBLIC_WEBSITE (pre-launch tsxmr.com), PORTAL, APP_STORE
gitCommit.body:
Separate release gates: PUBLIC_WEBSITE (pre-launch tsxmr.com), PORTAL, APP_STORE

The owner's brief of 2026-10-17 (second): the corporate website must be
publishable before the Dukan ERP backend, portal, registration, payments,
trial and account deletion work; the portal and App Store gates stay
strict, the WhatsApp deletion requirement included.

PUBLIC_WEBSITE (a public build, VITE_SITE_SURFACE=public):
- requires the TSX-MR identity and contacts (legal name, form, register
  number, city, address, support/privacy/security emails), the effective
  date, the origin https://tsxmr.com exactly, and TSX-MR's approval of its
  own pre-launch texts; refuses any portal, API, console or app-store
  address; no longer asks for the API, the deletion channel or support
  commitments;
- publishes pre-launch texts (EN/FR/AR): Dukan ERP "coming soon — not yet
  open for public registration"; no subscription, prices, trial,
  registration or sign-in; the privacy, terms, account-deletion, privacy-
  choices, legal-notice, security, support, about and contact pages
  describe this website only, from its code (no account, no form, no cookie
  of its own, language and display kept in the browser, Cloudflare
  delivery), and the processes that do not work yet as pre-launch
  information. All six legal texts are DRAFT until TSX-MR approves them.

PORTAL (a full build): unchanged rule, every input and the service's
approved texts; its verdict also lists the running backend and channels.
APP_STORE: the service texts approved with no blocker, the WhatsApp
deletion channel, and the external proofs (WhatsApp deletion end to end,
the mobile release check, docs/94). Both stay NO-GO from here.

scripts/release-verdicts.mjs prints the three verdicts (checks a built
public site's headers, code, links and browser run); build:public-release
is the Cloudflare build command (build + link audit + public bundle
audit). CI: the public site in Playwright (EN/FR/AR, 375 px and desktop,
axe, no foreign request, screenshots), and the verdicts as evidence.

Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>
